# File Upload

File Upload can be used to select one or several files on your computer and upload them to a server.

The component let you upload the files with a Button or by dropping files on a dedicated area.

See [File Upload guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/file-upload/design/)

<Canvas of={FileuploadStories.DragAndDrop} />

When user is dragging files over the component, use the `ds-fileupload-overlay` element with an updated message.
Duplicating elements in an overlay is necessary to keep the same global height.
